pkgmetadata.longdescription: Portable OMEMO (XEP-0384) implementation in C. Curve25519 and EdDSA are provided by the bundled HAcl amalgamation; the cryptographic backends use either the system Mbed TLS (default) or OpenSSL (openssl USE flag).

use.flag: Link against dev-libs/openssl instead of dev-libs/mbedtls for the cryptographic backend
